deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

kotoba/numeric_ref.kotoba.reason: Port legacy syntax to native selfhost and add a separate HTML-standard numeric reference decoder; the legacy decoder contract remains unchanged.

test/native/numeric_ref_html.kotoba.reason: Native fixture for HTML numeric references and legacy decoder behavior.

kotoba/htmldom_data.kotoba.reason: Native HTML data-state tokenizer step with explicit handoff to other states.

test/native/html_data_token.kotoba.reason: Native tests for data state, UTF-8 boundaries, numeric reference decoding and handoffs.

data/whatwg-entities.json.reason: Digest-pinned snapshot of the WHATWG named reference dataset.

data/whatwg-entities.provenance.json.reason: Source, retrieval date, digest and attribution for the named reference data.

scripts/generate_html_entities.py.reason: Deterministic offline regeneration from the digest-pinned source data.

kotoba/html_entities_data.kotoba.reason: Generated native lookup table for the pinned named reference data.

kotoba/html_named_ref.kotoba.reason: Native longest-match named reference decoder with attribute ambiguity handling.

test/native/html_named_ref.kotoba.reason: Native named reference and ambiguity fixture.

kotoba/htmldom_attribute.kotoba.reason: Native HTML attribute-value state with character-reference handling and explicit boundary tokens.

test/native/html_attribute_token.kotoba.reason: Native quoted and unquoted attribute-value cases and character-reference boundaries.
